### Zevia to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results on November 4, 2026


October 21, 2026


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Zevia PBC (“Zevia”) (NYSE: ZVIA), the Company that provides naturally delicious, zero sugar better-for-you beverages, today announced that it plans to release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Wednesday, November 4, 2026.


Zevia will also host a conference call to discuss its results at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time. Investors and other interested parties may listen to the webcast of the conference call by logging on via the Investor Relations section of Zevia’s website at[https://investors.zevia.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54625599&newsitemid=20261021832409&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2F&index=1&md5=c83a356fee0234c53e49f2760b3bb52a) . Those who wish to participate in the call may do so by dialing (877) 423-9813 or (201) 689-8573 for international callers, conference ID 13762906.


A replay of the webcast will be available for approximately thirty (30) days following the call at Zevia’s website at[https://investors.zevia.com/.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2F&esheet=54625599&newsitemid=20261021832409&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2F.&index=2&md5=cefd2b14c43474eb91113380f7bb2bc8) A copy of the earnings press release and supplemental financial disclosures will also be available on Zevia’s website at[https://investors.zevia.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2F&esheet=54625599&newsitemid=20261021832409&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.zevia.com%2F&index=3&md5=410a3a13742157cbae10a45b6cbe15f9) .


**About Zevia**


Zevia PBC is a Delaware public benefit corporation and Certified B Corporation offering a portfolio of naturally sweetened, better-for-you beverages made with simple, plant-based ingredients. Zevia® products are Non-GMO Project Verified, gluten-free, and vegan, and are distributed in more than 41,000 retail locations in the U.S. and Canada through a diverse network of major retailers in the grocery, drug, warehouse club, mass, natural, convenience and ecommerce channels. For more information, visit[www.zevia.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.zevia.com&esheet=54625599&newsitemid=20261021832409&lan=en-US&anchor=www.zevia.com&index=4&md5=ab44757040dc31e5d417ba2886b57e53) .
